question:
DRAG DROP -
An engineer is implementing NetFlow on a Cisco Nexus 7000 Series Switch.
Drag and drop the NetFlow commands from the left into the correct order they must be entered on the right.
items:
N7K-1(config)# interface <interface>
N7K-1(config-if)# ip flow monitor NetflowMonitor input

N7K-1(config)# flow exporter NetflowMonitor
N7K-1(config)# flow record NetflowMonitor
theory: NetFlow must be turned up in dependency order: first enable the feature (feature netflow), then build the pieces it needs — a flow exporter (where to send records) and a flow record (which fields/keys to match) — combine them into a flow monitor, and only then apply that monitor to an interface with "ip flow monitor ... input". Applying the monitor before the exporter/record exist, or before the feature is enabled, fails because the referenced objects do not yet exist. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — NetFlow)
